title: ProtocolMessage
description: A structured command sent by the coordinare to an agent via any transport. Transport-agnostic; serialised as JSON to stdin of the agent process (SubprocessTransport) or equivalent.

session_id.description: Identifies the agent session. Empty string on initial dispatch; must be the session_id returned in the dispatch response for status, relay_feedback, and health actions.

payload.description: Action-specific data. Shape varies by action (see dispatch_payload and relay_feedback_payload schemas). Empty object for status and health.

dispatch_payload.title: DispatchPayload
dispatch_payload.description: Payload for action=dispatch. Contains the full card context.

column.description: Board column name at time of dispatch (e.g. 'In Progress')

session_id.description: The session ID from the original dispatch response.

pr_url.description: URL of the pull request under review.

file.description: File path the comment applies to, if applicable.

line.description: Line number the comment applies to, if applicable.
